note: Iran's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Oil and gas reserves
spirits.description: Iran holds about a tenth of the world's proven oil reserves and about a seventh of its gas reserves.

spirits.name: A large public sector
spirits.description: The economy is mixed, with a large public sector.

spirits.name: Legacy of the war with Iraq
spirits.description: The war with Iraq from 1980 to 1988 left deep losses and a culture of self-reliance in defence.

spirits.name: Nuclear sanctions
spirits.description: International sanctions over the nuclear programme.

spirits.name: Resistance economy
spirits.description: Self-reliance in industry and finance under sanctions.

spirits.name: South Pars gas
spirits.description: Gas from the world's largest gas field for power and exports.
